text: A streamer goes live: one transaction launches a coin on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve.
sub: Solana devnet · signed with the app's local test wallet

text: First minute: the launch fee falls from 50% to 1%, so snipers don't win.
Viewers buy and sell on the curve. 80% of every fee goes to the streamer.
Every trade lands in Recent trades and on the live ticker tape.
The streamer claims their earnings any time.
The curve fills (0.1 SOL on devnet). Anyone graduates the coin into a Meteora DAMM v2 pool.
Trading goes on, now in the coin's Meteora pool.
The streamer's locked LP keeps earning pool fees. Claim in one click.
The OBS overlay puts the price and graduation bar on stream.
All on Meteora, all on-chain: the graduation tx and the memestream DBC config.
